access_scope: public original source HTML and indexed publisher/society educational content; no data download, protected data or video-content attestation
source_authority_policy: original dataset donor/owner or primary research > methodological guidelines > society educational/medical websites > videos/tutorials. Only original subject-level provenance, permitted aggregates or qualified human review can settle individual data chronology or original experiment claims.

source_catalog.finding: Official UCI describes 4 source sites, Cleveland n=303, num=0 vs 1..4; expanded attribute description gives 0 as <50% and 1 as >50%; exact 50% boundary remains unspecified.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: No case-by-case measurement chronology, local project 139/164 counted labels, or reproducibility of D-047 numerical results.

source_catalog.finding: Original UCI metadata states 303 records, nominal 54 features in four groups, and CAD defined by diameter narrowing >=50%.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: No owner-certified per-field acquisition timestamps, original 16-feature eligibility, BP/PR precise semantics or archived project's Cad/Normal totals.

source_catalog.finding: UCI labels it an extension of the same 303 patient records, adds angiography result features LAD/LCX/RCA/Cath and warns of selecting among them for other target tasks.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Not independent cohort, cannot show permitted pre-cath availability of post-reference angiography results; no new external validation.

source_catalog.finding: Original author's 2013 paper describes 303 Rajaie referrals and laboratory/echocardiography inputs to predict artery stenosis, with artery-specific endpoints and procedures.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Does not contain subject-level time stamps or certify current delivered workbook field meanings, 16/16 pre-angiography timing or project's new model performance.

source_catalog.finding: External validation sample size calculations should depend on anticipated event fraction, discrimination and calibration precision rather than a blanket sample-count rule.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Does not validate project-specific 382/459/315 calculations or constitute a completed real external validation.

source_catalog.finding: External evaluation requires independent evaluation data and assessments of calibration, discrimination and fit; an internal repeated CV is not a distinct external cohort.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Does not establish independence or validity of Hungary test cohort.

source_catalog.finding: TRIPOD+AI comprises 27 main reporting items for regression and machine-learning diagnostic/prognostic prediction studies.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Reporting checklist completeness is not proof of model validity or clinical approval; TRIPOD-LLM is not the suitable substitute for this tabular classifier.

source_catalog.finding: PROBAST+AI distinguishes appraisal of model development quality from evaluation risk of bias/applicability, across participants, predictors, outcome and analysis.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: A full item-by-item study-specific PROBAST+AI appraisal has not been performed here; no risk-of-bias certification.

source_catalog.finding: 2024 ESC clinical likelihood and diagnostic pathway provide clinical context, a distinct question from CardioAssist's historical source-specific research task.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Does not establish original UCI-412 recording time nor license copying/translating ESC clinical score into software. ESC page states software/algorithm use of guideline content requires formal license.

source_catalog.finding: ESC Congress 2024 physician session metadata: Dr Francisco Javier Rossello, 'Stepwise approach to the management of patients with suspected chronic coronary syndromes'. Video/slides link requires sign-in; its contents were NOT watched/verified.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: No dataset-specific feature chronology, CAD label definition, UCI codebook or approval can be inferred from video title.

source_catalog.finding: ACC 2025 TRIPOD+AI reporting webinar description explicitly lists reporting use cases and expert presenter Gary J. Collins; ACC embeds a YouTube recording. Webinar video not watched or transcribed by this audit.
source_catalog.does_not_establish: Does not authenticate project clinical measurements, historical experiments or source-specific clinical results.
